conviction_note: The print turns on the FY8/27 guide, and there is no free FY27 consensus to size it against. The documented pieces cancel: a probable small Q4 beat and a likely stable dividend increase on one side; on the other, the company's stated policy of setting FX assumptions stronger than spot, and the China DIA-bur restocking fade already visible in the Q3 短信. So the findings sum to 0.0 and p_up is 50. abs_move_pct is 7.0 because the last four verified prints moved 7.6-10.1%.
bar: FY8/26 operating profit. Company plan ¥9.7bn (revised 2026-07-15, https://tdnet-pdf.kabutan.jp/20260715/140120260619574493.pdf). IFIS consensus ¥9.88bn OP and ¥10.338bn ordinary (https://kabuyoho.jp/sp/reportAnalyst?bcode=7730, as of 2026-10-14). print_vs_bar is against the IFIS OP. The bar for the FY8/27 guide, the line that actually moves the stock, is UNSOURCED (no free 四季報 or IFIS FY27 number), so every guidance finding is capped small.
positioning_check: JPX short register: 0.0% disclosed (no holder at or above 0.5%), unchanged, as of 2026-10-14 (https://www.jpx.co.jp/markets/public/short-selling/index.html, from the baseline). 信用倍率 9.17x (https://kabutan.jp/stock/finance?code=7730, 2026-10-15), so leveraged retail is crowded long. Days to cover not available. No options and no skew. The baseline's priced_lean_pct is -0.745, mostly the margin overhang. The stock is ~14% below its pre-Q3 close (¥1,732 on 2026-07-15 against ¥1,497 spot). After Q3, Tokai Tokyo cut its target from ¥1,950 to ¥1,900 (Jul 29) and UBS from ¥2,170 to ¥2,060 (Jul 30) (https://kabutan.jp/stock/news?code=7730&b=n202607291236, https://kabutan.jp/stock/news?code=7730&b=n202607301274).

findings.finding: FY8/26 operating profit likely lands slightly above the ¥9.7bn plan, near the ¥9.88bn IFIS consensus. Q3 standalone OP was ¥2.389bn, while the plan implies a Q4 of only ¥2.214bn. Last year Q4 OP (¥2.058bn) exceeded Q3 (¥1.963bn). USD/JPY averaged roughly 157-161 over Jun-Aug against the 155 assumed in the July revision, and EUR/JPY ~178-186 against 182.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: The Q3 print (2026-07-15) raised FY OP from ¥9.2bn to ¥9.7bn and the stock fell 7.56% close to close, 'サプライズなし' (https://kabutan.jp/stock/news?code=7730&b=n202607160633). An in-line raise of the current year has been sold.
findings.why_not_priced: Mostly priced: IFIS already carries ¥9.88bn, above the plan. What remains is the size of the beat against consensus, which only the release shows. If the market expected a large beat, consensus would have moved in the last 4 weeks; kabuyoho shows the same ¥10.338bn ordinary consensus 1 and 4 weeks ago.
findings.independence: The FX assumption (155 USD, 182 EUR) is from a different document, the 2026-07-15 revision notice (https://tdnet-pdf.kabutan.jp/20260715/140120260619574493.pdf). The FX path is from Yahoo JPY=X monthly closes.

findings.finding: The FY8/27 guide will by stated policy use FX rates stronger than spot. The FY25 短信 says the assumption is set 現行レートより円高水準 (FY26 used 143 USD against spot ~150). With overseas sales at 84% and USD/JPY at ~157.7 today, the guided revenue, and to a lesser degree OP, will sit below a near-spot street model.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: The last new-year guide (2025-10-08) used the same conservative FX policy and still came in ~¥0.4bn above consensus at ¥9.2bn OP, with a midterm FY29 OP of ¥14.5bn; the stock rose 9.25% (https://kabutan.jp/stock/news?code=7730&b=n202510090469). The FY25 guide print (2024-10-07) moved -1.56% on Yahoo closes.
findings.why_not_priced: The policy is public and analysts know it, so most of it is priced. The finding is capped small because the FY27 consensus could not be sourced. The price does show the market marking the stock down since Q3: -14%, two target cuts, PER ~21.7 on the FY26 plan.
findings.independence: Overlaps the 2026-07-15 revision notice: the FX change from 143 to 155 lifted revenue by only ¥0.1bn and OP by ¥0.5bn, so FX transmits weakly to OP (https://tdnet-pdf.kabutan.jp/20260715/140120260619574493.pdf). That evidence also limits the downside of this finding.

findings.finding: China DIA-bur restocking is fading, which caps the FY27 dental growth base. The Q3 短信 guides full-year DIA-bur sales of ¥2.1bn against ¥1.708bn over 9M (Q1 ¥0.298bn, Q2 ¥0.831bn, Q3 ¥0.579bn), so Q4 is implied at ~¥0.39bn. That is down from Q3 and below FY24's ~¥0.64bn quarterly average, so the high-margin rebound that drove FY26 segment profit +102% does not repeat at that rate in FY27.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: The stock rose 7.79% (Jan 2026) and 10.05% (Apr 2026) while DIA-bur recovered, and fell 7.56% at the Q3 print where the full-year DIA-bur number implied the fade.
findings.why_not_priced: Largely priced. Anyone can compute it from the Q3 短信, and the post-Q3 de-rating and target cuts look like the market having read it. It stays as a small negative only because the FY27 guide will make it explicit.
findings.independence: Same document as the Q3 segment table. The Q3 短信 also says China surgical was weak on medical policy and distributor inventory adjustment. No different-source corroboration.

findings.finding: Shareholder returns are likely a small stable dividend increase and probably no buyback. The FY25 短信 commits to 安定的増配 (39 to 41 yen); FY26 EPS is guided at ¥69.03 (payout ~59%); the equity ratio is 92.4% and ROE 8.8% against the 12% the prior midterm plan targeted. Neither of the last two full-year prints carried a buyback.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: The 2025-10-08 print paired a 2-yen increase with the new guide and the stock rose 9.25%. The return item cannot be separated from the guide.
findings.why_not_priced: A 2-4 yen increase is the policy and is expected. The unpriced tail is a buyback or a payout-policy change given the 92% equity ratio, for which I found no evidence; hence the high end of the range.
findings.independence: Dividend history 23/30/35/39/39/41 and FY25 payout 82.7% from https://kabuyoho.jp/reportDps?bcode=7730 (2026-10-14).

outside_window.finding: Odne AG capital and business alliance (Japan exclusive distribution of root-canal devices). This is midterm product-portfolio news with no revenue path inside FY27 that is disclosed.

Returns: a stable dividend increase is expected (policy 安定的増配), and a buyback would be a surprise (none at the last two FY prints). New-year guide: the decisive item, set at yen-strong FX by policy, against an unsourced FY27 street number and a midterm FY29 OP path of ¥14.5bn. rejected_candidates.detail: Already in the baseline's lean_components (margin_overhang -0.481). Recorded in positioning_check, not as a finding
Market-wide, not company information, and the window starts at the 15:30 close, after the move. The stock was only -0.8% at 10:10

baseline_tension: Neutral. The lean (-0.745, margin overhang) and the +5.3% 20-day run-up are small against a name that moved 7.6-10.1% on each of its last four prints. The strongest positive the release could carry is an FY27 guide on the midterm path (~¥11bn OP) plus a dividend step-up or a first buyback against a 92% equity ratio. I looked for buyback precedent and found none; last year's guide beat the street by ~¥0.4bn despite the same FX conservatism, and that offsets the negatives.
lessons_applied: Rule 1 (a negative on a series the market already has): the DIA-bur fade is computable from the Q3 短信, so cut from -0.4 to -0.2; p_up from 48 to 50

Rule 1 / rule 2: the FX-policy negative is public in last year's 短信, and the same policy coexisted with a +9.25% guide print, so cut from -0.6 to -0.4. Rule 2 met by naming the strongest positive in baseline_tension
